parameters.description: The unique identifier of the space

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the text

x-enumDescriptions.paragraph_text: Return the text of a paragraph range.
x-enumDescriptions.paragraph_count: Return the number of paragraphs only.
x-enumDescriptions.text: Return the flattened plain text of the object.

parameters.name: fetch_type
parameters.description: Optional text fetch mode. Use one of: text, length, paragraph_count, paragraph_text. Defaults to text. Allowed values: text, length, paragraph_count, paragraph_text

parameters.name: text_query
parameters.description: `text_query` — JSON-encoded read options, URL-encoded. Optional in every mode. Omit it with fetch_type=text to read all text; pass {"payload":{"range":{"start_index":0,"end_index":5}}} with fetch_type=text to read a character range; pass {"payload":{"range":{"start_paragraph_index":0,"end_paragraph_index":1}}} with fetch_type=paragraph_text to read a paragraph range.
